## Professional biography

Guy Bavaro is a global business and technology executive who builds and scales businesses through commercial leadership, strategic partnerships and business development. His experience across EA, X/xAI, Snap, Microsoft and Yahoo spans gaming and interactive entertainment, social platforms, search, content and advertising technology. He leads Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships at Electronic Arts.

## Aggregate career outcomes

Guy states that he has generated more than $10 billion in advertising revenue across his career and helped scale businesses from zero to billions. This is an aggregate career statement, not company-specific revenue disclosure or a claim of sole individual sales credit.
Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#outcomes

## Career experience

### EA | Gaming & Interactive Entertainment

Head of Global Agency Development & Advertising Technology Partnerships. Lead Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships, building commercial opportunities across gaming, agencies, advertisers, and technology partners.

### X/xAI | Social Platforms & an Evolving AI Ecosystem

Head of Global Agency Development & Sales Partnerships. Led global agency development and sales partnerships at X, bringing together commercial teams, holding-company strategy, and advertising technology business development.

### Snap | Mobile, Social & Augmented Reality

Global Agency Development. Led global agency partnerships and commercial programs supporting advertiser adoption of emerging platform capabilities.

### Microsoft | Search, Video & Digital Advertising

Advertising Sales & Agency Development Leadership. Led advertising sales and agency development teams, built partnership programs, and developed commercial relationships across a broad technology portfolio.

### Yahoo | Search, Content & Digital Media

Global Agency Development. Led global agency development, commercial negotiations, and business development supporting search and native advertising adoption.

## Business leadership

### Business growth and commercialization

Translate new technology and changing consumer behavior into customer value, market adoption, and repeatable revenue.

### Team and organizational leadership

Build commercial teams, develop leaders, establish priorities, and create accountability for results.

### Strategic partnerships and business development

Structure and negotiate agreements that expand distribution, connect complementary capabilities, and open new markets.

### Technology, data, and measurement

Work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and Legal to connect technology partnerships with business objectives and measurable outcomes.

## Commercial expertise

### Advertising sales and commercial leadership

I build and lead commercial teams, develop leaders and establish accountability for revenue growth. My experience connects sales strategy, business development and partnership execution.

### Advertising technology business development

My advertising technology business development experience includes X and EA. I structure commercial partnerships and work across Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance and Sales to connect partner capabilities with advertiser needs and market adoption.

### Global agency partnerships and advertiser investment

I develop holding-company partnerships and joint business plans that connect executive strategy with agency planning, buying and activation. The objective is sustained advertiser adoption, investment and expansion.

### Data, measurement and attribution

I bring data partnerships, advertising measurement and attribution into commercial planning so advertisers can evaluate business outcomes and make informed investment decisions. This work connects partner capabilities, advertiser needs and commercial execution.

### Gaming and interactive entertainment

At Electronic Arts, I lead Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships across gaming and interactive entertainment, connecting agency demand with advertising opportunities built around participation and engagement.

### Commercialization, monetization and go-to-market strategy

I help turn new advertising capabilities into commercial propositions, partner programs and repeatable go-to-market execution. My experience spans search, video, social advertising, augmented reality and gaming.

### Commercial leadership for AI and emerging platforms

I’m interested in leading growth where technology is creating new markets. That includes AI, platforms, media, and other technology businesses seeking an executive who can connect strategy, teams, partnerships, and commercial execution.
